tax.statement: Prices do not include sales tax, and Aevium Labs does not currently collect sales tax at checkout. If your state requires you to pay use tax on purchases, you are responsible for reporting it.

retention: We keep order records, including contact and shipping details, for seven years to meet accounting and tax obligations, then delete them. Automatic database backups are kept for up to 30 days.

policies.shipping:
We ship within the United States only. Shipping is a flat $15.00 per order, shown at checkout.

Orders are prepared after we confirm your Zelle payment in our bank account. Most orders ship within 1–3 business days of payment confirmation. When your order ships, we email you the carrier and tracking number, and the details also appear under Your orders.

Please double-check your shipping address before placing your order. We are not responsible for packages delivered to an address entered incorrectly at checkout. If a package is lost in transit or arrives damaged, email orders@aeviumlabs.com within 7 days of the delivery date shown by the carrier and we will work with you on a resolution.
policies.refunds:
You can cancel an order at no charge before we confirm your payment: email orders@aeviumlabs.com with your order number. If you already sent payment for a cancelled order, we refund the full amount by Zelle.

Because our materials are sensitive research products, we cannot accept returns once an order has shipped. If you receive the wrong item, or an item arrives damaged, email orders@aeviumlabs.com within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos. After we review it, we will send a replacement or issue a refund by Zelle, at our choice.

Orders that are not paid within 3 days of being placed may be cancelled.
policies.terms:
All products sold by Aevium Labs are for laboratory research use only. They are not drugs, foods, dietary supplements or cosmetics, and they are not for human or animal consumption, diagnosis or treatment. By placing an order you confirm that you are at least 21 years old, that you are purchasing for legitimate research purposes, and that you will handle, store and dispose of the materials in line with applicable laws and laboratory practice.

Prices are in US dollars and may change without notice; the price shown when you place your order is the price you pay. Payment is by Zelle only, and an order is accepted once we confirm your payment. We may refuse or cancel any order, including when we cannot verify the order or when we believe the materials would not be used for research; in that case any payment received is refunded.

Product information on this website is provided for research reference only. To the extent permitted by law, our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages. Questions: orders@aeviumlabs.com.
